entries.name: Espanso GUI
entries.summary: GUI for the cross-platform text expander
entries.description: Espanso GUI provides a graphical interface for Espanso, a powerful cross-platform text expander. Create and manage text snippets, templates, and shortcuts that automatically expand as you type. Speed up your workflow by replacing abbreviations with full phrases, code snippets, or formatted text across any application.

entries.name: Lotti
entries.description: Lotti is a minimalist, distraction-free writing application designed for focused creative work. It strips away unnecessary UI elements so you can concentrate on your words. Perfect for drafting essays, stories, journal entries, or any long-form writing without the clutter of a full-featured word processor.

entries.name: Brief
entries.description: Brief is a clean, minimal note-taking app that focuses on simplicity and speed. Quickly jot down thoughts, create to-do lists, and organize your thoughts without unnecessary complexity.

entries.name: WonderPen
entries.summary: Distraction-free writing app for focused creativity
entries.description: WonderPen is a distraction-free writing environment built for authors, bloggers, and creative writers. It offers a clean, full-screen interface with minimal UI elements, markdown support, and export options.

entries.name: Tintero
entries.summary: Markdown editor with a clean, minimal interface
entries.description: Tintero is a modern Markdown editor with a clean, minimal interface designed for writers who prefer plain text. It features live preview, syntax highlighting, and seamless export to HTML and PDF.

entries.name: Sticky Notes
entries.summary: Simple sticky notes application for your desktop
entries.description: Sticky Notes brings the familiar post-it note experience to your Linux desktop. Create quick notes, pin them to your workspace, and organize them by color and position.

entries.name: Planify
entries.summary: Task management app with a beautiful UI
entries.description: Planify is a beautifully designed task management application that integrates with Todoist and local task lists. Organize your projects, set due dates, prioritize tasks, and track your progress with an intuitive interface.

entries.name: Koodo Reader
entries.summary: All-in-one ebook reader supporting many formats
entries.description: Koodo Reader is a versatile ebook reader that supports EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, CBZ, and many other formats. It features a clean reading interface with customizable fonts, themes, and reading modes.

entries.name: RemNote
entries.summary: Knowledge management and spaced repetition tool
entries.description: RemNote combines note-taking with spaced repetition flashcards to help you learn and retain information effectively. Create hierarchical notes, generate flashcards automatically, and review them using a scientifically-proven algorithm.

entries.name: Oboete
entries.summary: Flashcard and spaced repetition learning app
entries.description: Oboete is a flashcard application built around spaced repetition principles to maximize learning retention. Create custom decks, import existing cards, and review them on a schedule optimized for your memory.

entries.name: Memento
entries.description: Memento is a personal knowledge management tool that helps you capture, organize, and retrieve information efficiently. Create interconnected notes, tag them for easy searching, and build a personal wiki of your knowledge.

entries.name: Journal
entries.description: Journal is a straightforward diary and journaling application for Linux. Record your daily thoughts, track events, and maintain a personal log with date-stamped entries.

entries.name: Fast Reader GTK
entries.summary: Speed reading tool with GTK interface
entries.description: Fast Reader GTK is a speed reading application that uses RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) to help you read text faster. Paste articles, open documents, or load web content and read them word-by-word at adjustable speeds.

entries.name: Color My Desktop
entries.description: Color My Desktop lets you easily change and customize your desktop color scheme across GTK and Qt applications. Preview themes before applying, switch between light and dark modes, and fine-tune individual color elements.

entries.name: jd System Monitor
entries.summary: System resource monitoring and process viewer
entries.description: jd System Monitor provides a detailed view of your system resource usage including CPU, memory, disk, and network activity. Monitor running processes, track performance over time, and identify resource-hungry applications.

entries.name: Saldo
entries.description: Saldo is a personal finance application for tracking income, expenses, and budgets. Categorize your transactions, set spending limits, and visualize your financial habits with charts and reports.

entries.name: Network Displays
entries.summary: Stream your display over the network (Miracast)
entries.description: Network Displays enables wireless screen sharing via Miracast and related protocols on Linux. Project your desktop to compatible TVs, monitors, and receivers without cables.

entries.name: Document Scanner
entries.description: Document Scanner provides an easy way to scan documents and images from connected scanners. It features a straightforward interface for multi-page scanning, PDF export, and basic image adjustments. Part of the GNOME project.

entries.name: Ksnip
entries.description: Ksnip is a feature-rich screenshot tool that captures, annotates, and organizes screenshots on Linux. Take region, window, or full-screen captures, then add arrows, text, blur effects, and highlights before saving or sharing.

entries.name: GNOME Boxes
entries.description: GNOME Boxes makes it easy to create and manage virtual machines on Linux. Download operating systems, set up VMs with a few clicks, and connect to remote desktops.

entries.name: WinApps
entries.summary: Run Windows apps seamlessly on Linux
entries.description: WinApps allows you to run Windows applications natively on your Linux desktop by integrating them through a lightweight RDP connection to a Windows VM. Windows apps appear alongside your Linux applications with proper file associations.

entries.name: Nixite
entries.description: Nixite simplifies NixOS and Nix package manager configuration with a user-friendly interface. Manage your system configuration, install packages, and apply changes without writing Nix expressions by hand.

entries.name: Homepage
entries.summary: Modern, secure, and highly customizable application dashboard
entries.description: Homepage is a beautifully designed, self-hosted dashboard for organizing your services, bookmarks, and system information. Display widgets for weather, Docker containers, server stats, and more.

entries.name: digiKam
entries.description: digiKam is a professional-grade photo management application with powerful editing tools. Organize thousands of photos with tags, ratings, and facial recognition. Edit images with non-destructive adjustments and batch process large collections.

entries.name: FontForge
entries.description: FontForge is a comprehensive, open-source font editor for creating and modifying typefaces. Design glyphs, adjust kerning, convert between font formats, and create complete font families from scratch.

entries.name: QCanvas
entries.description: QCanvas is a drawing application built with Qt that provides a canvas for digital art, diagrams, and illustrations. It offers basic drawing tools, shape creation, and layer management.

entries.name: Theme Generator
entries.description: Theme Generator creates custom GTK themes from a base color scheme, allowing you to personalize your desktop appearance. Choose accent colors, generate light and dark variants, and apply themes system-wide.

entries.name: Wallpaper Downloader
entries.description: Wallpaper Downloader fetches high-quality wallpapers from multiple online sources and manages them on your system. Set automatic rotation, filter by resolution and category, and organize your wallpaper collection.

entries.name: Dynamic Wallpaper Editor
entries.summary: Create and edit dynamic wallpapers for GNOME
entries.description: Dynamic Wallpaper Editor lets you create animated, time-based wallpapers that change throughout the day. Combine multiple images into a single wallpaper XML file with transition effects.

entries.name: Wonderwall
entries.description: Wonderwall is a modern wallpaper manager that sources images from Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, and other platforms. Set wallpapers on a schedule, filter by tags and colors, and enjoy a fresh desktop background every day.

entries.name: ColorWall
entries.description: ColorWall generates beautiful gradient wallpapers from color palettes. Choose your colors, adjust the gradient style, and set it as your desktop background.

entries.name: Wardrobe
entries.summary: Theme and appearance manager for Linux
entries.description: Wardrobe is a comprehensive theme manager for Linux desktops that handles GTK themes, icon packs, cursors, and shell extensions. Browse, download, and apply themes from a unified interface.

entries.name: Linux Theme Store
entries.summary: Browse and install Linux themes and icons
entries.description: Linux Theme Store provides a curated marketplace for GTK themes, icon packs, cursor themes, and desktop wallpapers. Browse community-contributed themes, preview them before installing.

entries.name: Pling Store
entries.summary: Browse and install content from the OpenDesktop network
entries.description: Pling Store is the desktop client for the OpenDesktop.org network, providing access to thousands of themes, icons, wallpapers, and other desktop customizations. Browse categories, read reviews, and install content directly to your system.

entries.name: Warp
entries.description: Warp is a modern terminal emulator built with Rust for speed and reliability. It features AI-assisted command suggestions, block-based output rendering, and a text editor-like input experience.

entries.name: WezTerm
entries.description: WezTerm is a powerful, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and multiplexer written in Rust. It supports tabs, splits, ligatures, true color, and extensive configuration via Lua.

entries.name: Sublime Text
entries.summary: Sophisticated text editor for code and markup
entries.description: Sublime Text is a fast, polished text editor beloved by developers for its speed, multiple cursors, command palette, and extensive plugin ecosystem. It handles large files effortlessly and supports dozens of programming languages.

entries.name: Warp
entries.description: Warp is a modern terminal emulator built with Rust for speed and reliability. This AppImage version provides a portable installation that works across Linux distributions without system dependencies.

entries.name: Hyper
entries.summary: Extensible terminal built on web technologies
entries.description: Hyper is a beautiful, extensible terminal emulator built on HTML/CSS/JS. Customize every aspect with plugins and themes, and enjoy a consistent experience across platforms.

entries.name: Wave Terminal
entries.summary: Open-source terminal for the AI era with inline content
entries.description: Wave Terminal reimagines the terminal for the modern era with inline content rendering, AI integration, and a workspace-based interface. Run commands, view outputs, embed images and files, and collaborate with AI assistants.

entries.name: Kit
entries.description: Kit is a scriptable automation toolkit that lets you create desktop scripts, automate workflows, and build custom tools using JavaScript. Write scripts that interact with your OS, clipboard, files, and applications.

entries.name: Linux Toys
entries.summary: Collection of useful Linux utilities and scripts
entries.description: Linux Toys is a curated collection of handy Linux utilities, scripts, and tools for everyday desktop use. From system tweaks to productivity helpers, this project gathers useful small tools that make Linux more convenient.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.description: Zoom is a widely-used video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and online collaboration. Share your screen, record sessions, use virtual backgrounds, and connect with colleagues or friends from anywhere.

entries.name: Teams for Linux
entries.summary: Unofficial Microsoft Teams client for Linux
entries.description: Teams for Linux is an unofficial Microsoft Teams client that wraps the web application in a native desktop experience. Get notifications, system tray integration, and a dedicated window for Teams on Linux.

entries.name: Proton Mail
entries.description: Proton Mail is a privacy-focused email service with end-to-end encryption, zero-access architecture, and open-source clients. The desktop app provides a native experience for managing your encrypted email and organizing your inbox.

entries.name: Proton Pass
entries.description: Proton Pass is a secure password manager that stores and autofills your passwords, credit cards, and personal information. Built by the Proton team with the same privacy-first approach as Proton Mail.

entries.name: Ferdium
entries.summary: All-in-one messaging app combining Slack, WhatsApp, and more
entries.description: Ferdium combines all your messaging services into a single application with tabbed workspaces. Reduce window clutter, manage notifications centrally, and switch between services without losing focus. A fork of Franz with additional features and no paywalls.

entries.name: Mingle
entries.description: Mingle is a unified messaging application that brings together multiple chat and communication platforms into one organized workspace. Manage conversations across different services without switching between apps.

entries.name: Zen Browser
entries.description: Zen Browser is a modern web browser built with privacy and aesthetics in mind. It features a clean, minimal interface with vertical tabs, built-in ad blocking, and strong privacy protections. Based on Firefox engine.

entries.name: BrowserOS
entries.description: BrowserOS provides a lightweight, browser-centric desktop experience packaged as an AppImage. It transforms your Linux system into a focused web-browsing environment with kiosk-like simplicity.

entries.name: Tarot Caster
entries.summary: Tarot card reading and divination tool
entries.description: Tarot Caster provides an interactive tarot card reading experience with traditional card meanings and interpretations. Draw cards, explore their symbolism, and gain insights through classic tarot spreads.

entries.name: Tarot Canvas
entries.description: Tarot Canvas offers a visually rich tarot reading experience with beautiful card artwork and intuitive spread layouts. Explore card meanings, create custom readings, and save your sessions for reflection.

entries.name: Asteria
entries.description: Asteria is an astrology application that generates natal charts, transits, and synastry readings. Input birth details to create detailed astrological profiles with planetary positions, aspects, and house placements.

entries.name: AstroGods
entries.description: AstroGods combines mythology and astrology into an interactive reference application. Explore the connections between celestial bodies, mythological figures, and astrological meanings.

entries.name: Stellarium
entries.description: Stellarium is a free, open-source planetarium that renders a realistic 3D sky in real time. Explore stars, constellations, planets, nebulae, and galaxies from any location on Earth or in the solar system.

entries.name: Blanket
entries.summary: Listen to ambient sounds for focus and relaxation
entries.description: Blanket plays ambient background sounds to help you focus, relax, or sleep. Mix rain, wind, cafe noise, fire crackling, and other soundscapes to create your perfect audio environment.

entries.name: Anki
entries.description: Anki is the gold standard for spaced repetition flashcard learning. Create custom decks, download shared materials, and review cards on a schedule optimized by a proven algorithm. Supports rich text, images, audio, video, and LaTeX.

entries.name: SpMp
entries.description: SpMp is a lightweight Spotify-compatible music player client for Linux. Stream music, manage playlists, and control playback with a native desktop interface.

entries.name: WPS Office
entries.summary: Full office suite with word processor, spreadsheets, and presentations
entries.description: WPS Office is a comprehensive office suite compatible with Microsoft Office formats. It includes Writer, Spreadsheets, and Presentation with a familiar ribbon interface. Excellent compatibility with .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files.

entries.name: Catalyst
entries.description: Catalyst is a productivity application designed to streamline your daily workflow. Organize tasks, track habits, manage projects, and set goals all in one place.

entries.name: Agenda
entries.description: Agenda is a lightweight calendar and scheduling application for managing your appointments and events. View your schedule in day, week, or month layouts, create recurring events, and set reminders.

entries.name: Add Water
entries.summary: Hydration reminder and water intake tracker
entries.description: Add Water is a simple hydration reminder that prompts you to drink water throughout the day. Track your daily water intake, set personalized goals, and receive gentle notifications to stay hydrated.

entries.name: Touche
entries.description: Touche lets you customize multi-touch gestures on your Linux touchpad. Define custom actions for swipes, pinches, and taps to navigate your desktop more efficiently.

entries.name: Sitra
entries.description: Sitra provides a comprehensive overview of your systems hardware and software configuration. View CPU, memory, storage, and network details in a clean, organized interface.

entries.name: Taigo
entries.description: Taigo is a rhythm game client that lets you play popular rhythm game song charts on Linux. Import song packs, customize key bindings, and enjoy precise timing judgment.

entries.name: Firefox
entries.description: Firefox is a full-featured web browser with tracking protection, syncing, extensions, and strong Linux desktop integration. It blocks third-party trackers by default, supports container tabs, and offers a vast library of add-ons.

entries.name: GIMP
entries.description: GIMP is a professional raster graphics editor used for photo retouching, illustration, compositing, and asset production. It offers layers, masks, filters, custom brushes, and extensive plugin support.

entries.name: VLC
entries.description: VLC plays local files, network streams, and discs with wide codec support and a lightweight desktop UI. It handles virtually every media format without requiring additional codec packs and supports hardware acceleration.

entries.name: Spotify
entries.description: Spotify gives you instant access to millions of songs, from old favorites to the latest hits. The Linux client provides native desktop integration with media keys, system tray controls, and notification support.

entries.name: Code
entries.description: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor with built-in support for JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and a rich ecosystem of extensions. Features IntelliSense, debugging, Git integration, and a built-in terminal.

entries.name: Obsidian
entries.description: Obsidian is a local-first Markdown knowledge base with backlinking, graph navigation, and plugin extensibility. Build a personal wiki of interconnected notes, visualize relationships between ideas, and extend functionality with plugins.

entries.name: Discord
entries.summary: All-in-one voice, video, and text communication
entries.description: Discord is a communication platform designed for communities and friend groups. Create servers with text channels, voice channels, and video calls. Share your screen, stream games, and organize conversations.

entries.name: Spotify
entries.description: Spotify is the worlds most popular music streaming service with millions of songs, playlists, and podcasts. The Snap package provides easy installation with automatic updates.

entries.name: Vlc
entries.description: VLC is the legendary media player that plays everything. The Snap package provides the latest version with automatic updates and sandboxed security.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Slack is a team communication platform with channels, direct messages, file sharing, and integrations with hundreds of tools. The Snap package delivers the latest desktop client with automatic updates.

entries.name: Telegram-Desktop
entries.description: Telegram Desktop is the official desktop client for Telegrams cloud-based messaging service. Enjoy fast message delivery, end-to-end encrypted secret chats, large file sharing, and powerful group management.

entries.name: Signal-Desktop
entries.description: Signal Desktop extends Signals encrypted messaging to your Linux desktop. Send text messages, make voice and video calls, and share files all protected by state-of-the-art end-to-end encryption.

entries.name: Whatsapp-For-Linux
entries.description: WhatsApp for Linux wraps the WhatsApp Web interface in a native desktop application with system tray integration and notifications.

entries.name: Firefox
entries.summary: Fast, private, and safe web browser
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation. The Snap package provides automatic background updates and enhanced security through sandboxing.

entries.name: Chromium
entries.description: Chromium is the open-source browser project that forms the basis for Google Chrome and many other browsers. The Snap package provides automatic updates and a secure, sandboxed browsing experience.

entries.name: Brave
entries.summary: Privacy-first web browser with ad blocking
entries.description: Brave is a privacy-focused web browser that blocks ads and trackers by default. Built on Chromium for compatibility, it includes a built-in ad blocker, HTTPS Everywhere, and fingerprinting protection.

entries.name: Postman
entries.description: Postman is the industry-standard tool for API development, testing, and documentation. Create and send HTTP requests, organize them into collections, automate testing, and collaborate with your team.

entries.name: Docker
entries.description: Docker provides containerization tools for building, shipping, and running applications in isolated environments. The Snap package includes the Docker CLI and daemon for managing containers, images, and networks.

entries.name: Notion-Snap
entries.summary: All-in-one workspace for notes and projects
entries.description: Notion combines notes, databases, kanban boards, wikis, and calendars into a single workspace. The Snap package wraps the Notion web app in a native desktop client with system integration.

entries.name: Figma-Linux
entries.description: Figma is a cloud-based design tool for creating interfaces, prototypes, and design systems. The Linux Snap package provides desktop access to Figmas powerful collaborative design platform.

entries.name: Obs-Studio
entries.summary: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming
entries.description: OBS Studio is the leading open-source software for video recording and live streaming. Capture your screen, webcam, and audio sources, compose them into scenes, and stream to YouTube, Twitch, or any RTMP server.

entries.name: Kdenlive
entries.description: Kdenlive is a powerful, open-source video editor based on the MLT Framework and KDE frameworks. Multi-track editing, proxy editing, color correction, effects, and transitions make it suitable for professional video production.

entries.name: Kdenlive
entries.description: Kdenlive is a powerful, open-source video editor based on the MLT Framework. It features multi-track editing, proxy editing for smooth performance, a wide range of effects and transitions, color correction tools, and audio mixing.

entries.name: Inkscape
entries.description: Inkscape is a professional-quality vector graphics editor with capabilities similar to Adobe Illustrator. Create illustrations, icons, logos, diagrams, and more using bezier curves, shapes, text tools, and path operations.

entries.name: Blender
entries.description: Blender is the free and open-source 3D creation suite supporting the entirety of the 3D pipeline - modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing, motion tracking, video editing, and 2D animation pipeline.

entries.name: Audacity
entries.summary: Free, open-source audio editor and recorder
entries.description: Audacity is a free, easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder. Record live audio, convert tapes and records to digital, edit sound files, and apply effects like noise removal, equalization, and compression.

entries.name: OBS Studio
entries.summary: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming
entries.description: OBS Studio offers real-time video/audio capture and compositing, scene composition with unlimited sources, encoding with x264 and NVENC, and direct streaming to Twitch, YouTube, and other platforms.

entries.name: LibreOffice
entries.description: LibreOffice is a powerful, free office suite with Writer (word processor), Calc (spreadsheets), Impress (presentations), Draw (vector graphics), Math (formulas), and Base (databases). Full compatibility with Microsoft Office formats.

entries.name: Thunderbird
entries.description: Thunderbird is a free email application from Mozilla that is easy to set up and customize. Manage multiple email accounts, calendars, contacts, and tasks in one place. Features powerful search and extensive add-on support.

entries.name: FileZilla
entries.summary: Fast and reliable FTP, FTPS, and SFTP client
entries.description: FileZilla is a fast, reliable, and feature-rich FTP, FTPS, and SFTP client. Transfer files between your computer and remote servers with drag-and-drop simplicity, site manager for multiple connections, and remote file editing.

entries.name: KeePassXC
entries.summary: Community fork of KeePassX cross-platform password manager
entries.description: KeePassXC is a modern, secure, and open-source password manager. Store all your passwords in an encrypted database protected by a master password. Features auto-type, browser integration, TOTP generation, and password strength analysis.

entries.name: Bitwarden
entries.description: Bitwarden is an open-source password manager that securely stores and syncs your passwords across all devices. Features password generation, secure notes, two-factor authentication, and self-hosting options.

entries.name: Joplin
entries.description: Joplin is a free, open-source note-taking and to-do application with support for Markdown, notebooks, tags, and end-to-end encrypted synchronization. Sync via Dropbox, OneDrive, Nextcloud, or the Joplin Cloud service.

entries.name: Logseq
entries.description: Logseq is a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base that works with Markdown and Org-mode files. Build a network of interconnected notes with bidirectional linking, block references, and a graph view. Local-first storage.

entries.name: Mark Text
entries.description: Mark Text is a simple and elegant Markdown editor focused on speed and ease of use. Features a WYSIWYG-like editing experience with live preview, export to HTML and PDF, and support for math formulas and diagrams.

entries.name: Typora
entries.summary: Minimal Markdown editor with live preview
entries.description: Typora is a minimal Markdown editor that seamlessly blends editing and preview into a single interface. Write Markdown and see the formatted result instantly. Supports tables, code blocks, math formulas, diagrams, and export.

entries.name: Signal
entries.description: Signal is the gold standard for private messaging with state-of-the-art end-to-end encryption. Send text messages, make voice and video calls, share files, and create group chats - all protected by the Signal Protocol.

entries.name: Telegram
entries.summary: Cloud-based messaging with speed and security
entries.description: Telegram is a cloud-based messaging app focused on speed and security. Send messages, photos, videos, and files of any type and size. Create groups with up to 200,000 members, channels for broadcasting, and bots.

entries.name: Discord
entries.summary: Voice, video, and text communication for communities
entries.description: Discord is the go-to platform for voice, video, and text communication in communities and friend groups. Create servers with organized channels, share your screen, stream games, and integrate with bots and services.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Slack brings team communication and collaboration into one place with channels, direct messages, file sharing, and hundreds of integrations. The AppImage version runs on any Linux distribution without installation.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.description: Zoom is the leading video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and online collaboration. The AppImage version provides a portable installation that works across distributions with screen sharing and virtual backgrounds.

entries.name: Sublime Text
entries.summary: Sophisticated text editor for code and markup
entries.description: Sublime Text is a sophisticated text editor for code, markup, and prose. Features include multiple selections, command palette, minimap, split editing, and a powerful plugin API. Blazingly fast performance even with large files.

entries.name: Atom
entries.summary: A hackable text editor for the 21st Century
entries.description: Atom is a hackable text editor built on web technologies with Git integration, a package manager, smart autocompletion, and multiple panes. Customize everything with CSS and extend functionality with thousands of community packages.

entries.name: Stellarium
entries.summary: Free planetarium software showing realistic 3D sky
entries.description: Stellarium renders a realistic 3D sky in real time, showing stars, constellations, planets, nebulae, and more from any location on Earth. Used by amateur astronomers, educators, and planetariums.

entries.name: Neovim
entries.description: Neovim is a refactor of Vim focused on extensibility and usability. It features a built-in LSP client, tree-sitter parsing for better syntax highlighting, asynchronous plugin support, and a modern API.

entries.name: lazygit
entries.summary: Simple terminal UI for git commands
entries.description: lazygit is a simple terminal UI for git commands that makes complex git operations intuitive and fast. Stage individual lines, resolve merge conflicts visually, rebase interactively, and manage branches with keyboard shortcuts.

entries.name: bat
entries.summary: A cat clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration
entries.description: bat is a cat clone with wings - it adds syntax highlighting, Git integration, and automatic paging to the classic cat command. View file contents with color-coded syntax for hundreds of languages.

entries.name: fd
entries.summary: A simple, fast, and user-friendly alternative to find
entries.description: fd is a fast, user-friendly alternative to the find command. It features colorful output, regex and glob patterns, parallel execution, and smart case-insensitive search by default.

entries.name: ripgrep
entries.summary: A line-oriented search tool that recursively searches directories
entries.description: ripgrep (rg) is an extremely fast line-oriented search tool that recursively searches your current directory for a regex pattern. It combines the usability of The Silver Searcher with the raw speed of GNU grep.

entries.name: zoxide
entries.summary: A smarter cd command that learns your habits
entries.description: zoxide is a smarter cd command that remembers which directories you use most frequently. Instead of typing long paths, just type z proj to jump to your project directory.

entries.name: Starship
entries.summary: The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt
entries.description: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable shell prompt for any shell. It shows git branch, package versions, command duration, and more in a beautiful, cross-shell compatible format.

entries.name: htop
entries.summary: Interactive process viewer and system monitor
entries.description: htop is an interactive process viewer and system monitor that improves upon the traditional top command. It features a colorful, tree-view display, mouse support, easy process killing, and search/filter capability.

entries.name: tmux
entries.summary: Terminal multiplexer for managing multiple terminal sessions
entries.description: tmux is a terminal multiplexer that lets you switch between multiple programs in one terminal, detach them to run in the background, and reattach them later. Essential for remote work and long-running processes.

entries.name: fzf
entries.description: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder that works with any list - files, command history, processes, hostnames, bookmarks, and more. Its interactive fuzzy matching makes finding items in large lists instant.

entries.name: Google Chrome
entries.summary: Fast, secure web browser from Google
entries.description: Google Chrome is the worlds most popular web browser, known for its speed, simplicity, and security. Features include tabbed browsing, bookmark syncing, extension support, and built-in Google services integration.

entries.name: Visual Studio Code
entries.description: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor with built-in support for JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and a rich ecosystem of extensions. Features IntelliSense, debugging, and Git integration.

entries.name: Docker Desktop
entries.description: Docker Desktop provides a complete containerization platform with a graphical management interface. Build, share, and run containerized applications with integrated Kubernetes, volume management, and extension support.

entries.name: Rectangle
entries.summary: Move and resize windows using keyboard shortcuts
entries.description: Rectangle is a window management app that lets you move and resize windows using keyboard shortcuts or snap areas. A free, open-source alternative to Spectacle with additional features.
